brief_title: The Effect of Insulin Detemir on Blood Glucose Control in Taiwanese Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Failing on OAD
official_title: Safety and Therapeutic Effect of Insulin Detemir in Taiwanese Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Not Achieving Glycaemic Targets With OAD With/Without Once-daily NPH Insulin Treatment

primary_outcomes.measure: Incidence of serious adverse events, including major hypoglycaemic events
primary_outcomes.time_frame: during 16 weeks of insulin detemir therapy

brief_summary: The trial is conducted in Asia. The aim of the trial is to evaluate the effect of insulin detemir on blood glucose control in Taiwanese patients with type 2 diabetes failing on OAD with/without once-daily NPH Insulin treatment.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes
* HbA1C: 7.0-11.0%
* Previous diabetes treatment for at least 6 months
* BMI max. 35 kg/m2
* Treatment with an oral anti-diabetic drug (OAD)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes
* Receipt of any investigational drug within the last three months prior to this trial
